result.topic_en: Notes on the 'Melioramente' (characteristic-type combinations of square-root functions of the variables x, y, z, ... for an Abelian/theta-function setting), with their characteristics written as 3x2 arrays of 0s and 1s, index combinatorics, and quotients of theta functions expressed through square roots of linear forms.

methods.what: Quadratic relations among products of the linear forms underlying the square-root functions (conic/quartic identities)
Assignment of 3x2 theta characteristics (0/1 arrays) to square roots of the linear forms
Addition of characteristics for quotients of square roots
Index combinatorics of relations among the root functions numbered 1..10
Expression of an algebraic square-root quotient as a quotient of theta functions with characteristics times an exponential factor
Theta-constant quotient squared expressed via values of the linear forms at special points
